purpose: Teach: スタンプ/コロッケ/たこ焼き/シロ/タケ/カブ/みそ/ルータ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、スタンプ、いっぱい集めたよ!
lines.en: Mom, I collected so many stamps!
lines.style: Bright, eager burst from the moment he opens his mouth. Slight breathlessness—he's been holding this news. Quick pace, unbridled. No filter between thought and voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。夕飯、コロッケ、揚げるね。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. I'll fry up some croquettes for dinner.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, gently distracted. She's already pivoting to the practical—what comes next. Soft, almost humming the words. A mother's quiet contentment in small promises kept.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祭りで、たこ焼き、食べたい!
lines.en: I want to eat takoyaki at the festival!
lines.style: Quick surge of want—not demanding, but vivid. He sees it already. Slight uplift at the end, testing whether this is allowed. Lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達の犬、シロちゃん、可愛いよね。
lines.en: Your friend's dog Shiro is really cute, isn't she?
lines.style: Warm observation, gently drawing him in. She's noticing what he noticed. Soft smile audible. Pace unhurried—she's not moving on to the next thing yet.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園のタケ、高くて、面白い。
lines.en: That tall bamboo in the park is so interesting.
lines.style: Wonder-struck but grounded. He's marveling at the simple fact of it. Slight wonder on the opening, then settling into genuine observation. Quiet delight, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今夜、カブのスープ、作るね。
lines.style: Matter-of-fact care. She's planning his comfort in the smallest ways. Gentle, almost half-spoken—she knows he's listening. No fanfare, just the texture of love in routine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright assertion, simple certainty. He knows what he loves and he's telling her. Quick, unburdened. The voice of a child who feels safe enough to have preferences.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、ルータ、修理してくれた。
lines.en: Dad fixed the router for us.
lines.style: Small, genuine wonder at an act of care. Not hero-worship, but the relief that something broken is whole again. Soft landing on the closing word—he's satisfied.
